description_zh: 调用AddHotlineNumber接口新增热线号码
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs add-hotline-number --instance-id 'ccc_xp_pre-cn-***' --hotline-number '05710000****' --description '热线号码' --enable-inbound true --enable-outbound true --outbound-all-depart true --enable-inbound-evaluation true --enable-outbound-evaluation true --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddHotlineNumber

parameters.help_en: The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance ID. You can obtain the ID from the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。可在智能联络中心控制台上获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the hotline number
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the hotline number is used for inbound calls
parameters.name: enable_inbound

parameters.help_en: The ID of the inbound IVR flow. You can obtain the ID from the Hotline > Channel Access > IVR Flow Management page in the SaaS workspace
parameters.help_zh: 入呼IVR流程ID。可通过SaaS工作台热线>渠道接入>IVR流程管理页面获取
parameters.name: inbound_flow_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the hotline number is used for outbound calls
parameters.name: enable_outbound

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether outbound calls apply to all departments under the instance
parameters.help_zh: 外呼是否对实例下所有部门生效
parameters.name: outbound_all_depart

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the satisfaction survey for inbound calls
parameters.name: enable_inbound_evaluation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the satisfaction survey for outbound calls
parameters.name: enable_outbound_evaluation

parameters.help_en:
The satisfaction level. Valid values:

2: Level 2 (Satisfied, Dissatisfied).
3: Level 3 (Satisfied, Neutral, Dissatisfied).
4: Level 4 (Very satisfied, Satisfied, Neutral, Dissatisfied).
5: Level 5 (Very satisfied, Satisfied, Neutral, Dissatisfied, Very dissatisfied)
parameters.help_zh:
满意度等级。取值：

2：二级（满意，不满意）
3：三级（满意，一般，不满意）
4：四级（很满意，满意，一般，不满意）
5：五级（很满意，满意，一般，不满意，非常差）
parameters.name: evaluation_level

fields.help_en: The ID of the effective department
fields.name: department_id

fields.help_en:
The list of effective skill groups.
If the skill group list is empty, the configuration applies to the entire department. Otherwise, it applies only to the specified skill groups under the department
fields.help_zh:
生效技能组列表。
技能组列表为空则对整个部门生效，否则针对部门下指定技能组列表生效
fields.name: group_id_list

parameters.help_en: The effective scope of outbound calls
parameters.name: outbound_range_list

Code.description_en: The status code. A return value of Success indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call succeeded
